candidate_relations.reason: Macrodactyly of the left middle finger correctly identifies the anatomical finding and location but does not specify the lipomatous etiology (macrodystrophia lipomatosa) that the CT scan explicitly suggests and that the reference diagnosis requires. candidate_relations.scope_detail: Macrodactyly is the anatomical/clinical descriptor (enlarged digit); macrodystrophia lipomatosa is the specific etiologic subtype of macrodactyly characterized by lipomatous overgrowth, which is what the CT findings and clinical picture support

case_quality_flags: CT findings explicitly point to lipomatous process, making macrodystrophia lipomatosa the required specific diagnosis rather than the generic macrodactyly descriptor
